item.tib: spyi spungs bde gshegs bka' brgyad kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char rgyun
item.coloph: gsang bdag gsang ba 'dus pas legs par bsngags shing dngos byin rlabs pa zab gsang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyi shu/ bsnyon med 'ja' lus su grub pa bdun sogs bka' babs rig 'dzin brgyad kyi dbang thob pa'i skye ba 'dzin pa rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis rigs bzhi rigs kyi g.yung drung sku yi gnas chen rin chen 'bar ba'i mthil mtsho steng gsang sngags bde ldan khrod du/ sngon gyer spungs chen po nas da lta yan chad du sa gnon gyi bon sde'i rgyun ma 'chad (chad) pa'i dbus su 'khod pa'i 'chi med g.yung drung bkod pa'i khang bzang du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//
